summary: The rally has broadened into the afternoon. The Nifty is up a third of a percent and back at Monday's close, volatility is sliding, and IT keeps leading.

detail.leaders: IT, PSU banks, Oil & Gas, Chemicals; ICICI Bank, TCS, Reliance; MidCap +0.58%, SmallCap +0.74%
detail.tone: Stronger than 13:00: at 1 pm the Nifty was up 74.75 (+0.33%) at 22,790.95 and the Sensex up 460.41 (+0.63%) at 72,989.48. That reclaims Monday's 22,780 close and wipes out Tuesday's loss.
watch: Holding above 22,780 into the close, which would snap the two-day losing run
